terms.label: microscopy
terms.definition: Imaging of a specimen at magnification using a microscope.

terms.label: light-sheet microscopy
terms.definition: Fluorescence microscopy in which the sample is illuminated from the side by a thin sheet of light, so that only the focal plane is excited, and imaged through a detection objective perpendicular to the sheet.

terms.label: high content microscopy
terms.definition: Automated microscopy of many samples, typically in multi-well plates, combined with quantitative image analysis that extracts many measurements per cell or sample.
